title: Interview note I-001: C-001 for J-001 (technical)
text: Technical interview for Senior Backend Engineer. Ana explained how she partitioned Kafka topics by order id to keep ordering and scaled consumers horizontally. Strong system design; clear ownership of on-call. Scores: technical depth 5, system design 4, delivery 5, collaboration 4. Outcome: advanced to final round.

title: Interview note I-002: C-003 for J-001 (screening call)
text: Screening call for Senior Backend Engineer. Jordan has mostly frontend experience and no production Kafka or Python backend ownership. Scores: technical depth 2, system design 2, delivery 3, collaboration 4. Outcome: rejected, does not meet the Python and Kafka requirements.

title: Interview note I-003: C-005 for J-002 (final)
text: Final interview for Data Scientist, Experimentation. Priya walked through an uplift-model test that raised adherence by 9% and explained guardrail metrics. Scores: statistics 5, data engineering 3, business impact 5, communication 5. Outcome: hired.

title: Interview note I-004: C-002 for J-001 (final)
text: Final interview for Senior Backend Engineer. Tomás described a Debezium change data capture pipeline into Kafka and how he handled schema evolution. Scores: technical depth 4, system design 4, delivery 4, collaboration 4. Outcome: offer made.
